view.stem: 图中是早期有线电话的送话器、受话器及电流随时间变化的示意。电源和其他条件保持不变时，哪一项同时正确说明两种装置的构造、工作过程和双方通话的方式？电流图没有数值刻度，只作定性判断。

送话端：靠近嘴部的送话器又叫微音器。振膜6是钢或压制碳薄片，碳粉5装在碳靴2的凹槽中。碳靴2和底部电极3都与外壳1导电相接，衬垫4用于固定；电源电流经过振膜、外壳、碳粉和电极。空气的声振动使振膜振动，改变颗粒接触和压力，再改变电阻及电源提供的电流。无声时电流恒定，对应AB；有声时电流在直流基础上强弱变化，对应BC，方向不反转。
受话端：靠近耳部的受话器中，外壳2内的永磁铁3有两个极靴，极靴上套着细导线线圈4。圆形钢薄片振膜1由盖板5压在外壳上，并紧贴两极靴。无线圈电流时，永磁铁使膜稍稍下凹；恒定电流使膜保持静态位置。变化电流改变极靴对膜的接触压力，极靴通过直接接触推动膜，使膜和邻近空气振动。
通话：声带振动引起空气振动，经送话器改变电流，电话线传送电流变化；另一端的受话器把它变成当地空气的振动。声振动控制电流变化，电源提供电能。对方回复时，使用对方的送话器传送变化，由自己的受话器产生声音；两种装置各自的转换作用不变。

intent.task: Recognize one complete physically coherent account of the early telephone system. Account for the transmitter and receiver definitions and positions; all numbered transmitter parts, materials, insulation and supplied-current path; sound/diaphragm/grain-contact/pressure/resistance/current causation and constant-versus-pulsating DC states; all numbered receiver parts, magnet/pole/coil/steel-diaphragm/gap/cover construction; no-current, constant-current and varying-current magnetic behavior; and the whole voice-to-local-sound chain including the opposite direction of a conversation. The response is not part naming or numerical graph reading.
intent.source_solution: The full independently established solutions to sources 1 through 4 were frozen before any alternatives in source-solution-before-options.json/md, bound by source-solution-freeze.json. Substantively: the near-mouth transmitter/microphone converts sound-induced vibration to electrical variation; the near-ear receiver converts incoming electrical variation into diaphragm and local-air vibration. Transmitter housing 1 holds carbon shoe 2 with powder 5 in its recess; pad 4 insulates the shoe from the housing and base-mounted fixed electrode 3 is also insulated from the housing. Diaphragm 6 is a thin steel or pressed-carbon sheet. The powered-current path passes through diaphragm, carbon shoe, powder and electrode. Voice-induced air vibration moves the diaphragm and changes grain contact and pressure, then resistance, then supplied current. Sound modulates the signal, while the supply provides electrical energy. With fixed supply and other conditions, no sound-induced motion leaves resistance and current unchanged, corresponding qualitatively to AB; sound causes DC strength variation, corresponding to BC, without repeated current-direction reversal. Receiver housing 2 contains permanent magnet 3 with two pole shoes and fine-wire coils 4. Circular thin steel diaphragm 1 is supported on the housing and clamped by cover 5, leaving a small gap above the poles. Without coil current, the permanent magnet already draws it slightly concave. Constant coil current yields a static combined magnetic action and diaphragm position. Varying coil current changes the additional field, combined attraction and diaphragm force; the moving diaphragm drives local air and creates sound. For a conversation, vocal-fold/air/diaphragm motion at the speaking end changes carbon contact/resistance and supplied current; the wire conveys the electrical variation to receiver coils, whose varying field plus permanent field changes force, diaphragm motion and local air vibration at the listener. On reply the other person's transmitter and the first person's receiver perform their usual respective conversions, rather than exchanging device functions. The drawings provide construction and qualitative states, not numerical waveform, gap size, battery polarity, winding direction, delay, quantitative fidelity or detailed circuit topology.
intent.unit_reason: The selected tasks form one causally connected apparatus explanation rather than four unrelated problems: device definitions are realized by the two construction-and-operation chains, and both chains are necessary to explain the conversation. One native single-choice comparison of complete models preserves that connection and avoids separate questions exposing each other's keyed account. Four parallel candidates present the same three sections and facets, so the learner judges construction and causation rather than clicking each label or each graph segment. The merge follows the physical relationship, not a question quota or printed source numbering. Eliminating a faulty complete model is legitimate recognition, but does not establish that the learner can independently produce every step of the explanation.
limitations: Selecting a complete account does not demonstrate independently writing the receiver and transmitter definitions or choosing explanatory vocabulary.

Recognition of a presented apparatus account does not demonstrate independently producing the full construction descriptions, including materials, component relationships, insulation, current path, diaphragm support and pole gap.
Recognition of a complete causal account does not demonstrate independently generating and sequencing all transmitter, receiver and two-way-conversation steps without alternatives.

Correct selection or elimination does not separately certify mastery of every shared clause about energy supply, current states or local sound, even though those facets are retained in every candidate account.
The source's early simplified-circuit explanation is retained; no detailed circuit design, measured graph analysis or drawing-production ability is added or claimed.

rationales.derivation: Combine two already established physical mistakes. First infer electrical continuity from mechanical mounting: connect carbon shoe 2 and base electrode 3 conductively to housing 1, treat pad 4 as only a fixing pad, and substitute the housing for the carbon shoe in the supplied-current route. This reproduces the transmitter section but violates the insulation in definition 1 and the diaphragm/carbon-shoe/powder/electrode path in definition 8. Next assume magnetic movement requires direct pole contact: close the small diaphragm/pole gap and replace varying magnetic attraction with pressure transmitted by the pole shoes. This reproduces the receiver section but violates the gap in definition 15 and combined additional-coil/permanent-field attraction in definition 18. The conversation section remains the original account of ordinary transmitter/receiver reply roles. Either construction/operation defect suffices to make the complete model false; combining them does not change the meanings of either existing contrast.
rationales.misconception: Apply both existing mistaken procedures: turn mechanical mounting into electrical continuity and a housing current path, then turn noncontact magnetic attraction into direct pole-pressure transfer by closing the diaphragm gap.

rationales.derivation: Retain the original insulated transmitter/current-path section and combine two other existing physical mistakes. Assume magnetic movement requires contact with the pole shoes; remove the small gap and replace changing combined magnetic attraction with a contact-pressure push, yielding the stated receiver arrangement and operation. Definitions 15 and 18 instead require the small gap and the coil field acting with the permanent magnet to vary attraction. Then infer that reversing who speaks reverses each device's conversion function: assign reply air-to-current conversion to the other person's receiver and current-to-sound conversion to the first person's transmitter. That reproduces the conversation section but contradicts the same respective device functions in definitions 0, 2 and 3. Either the contact-transfer error or the reversed-hardware-role error invalidates this complete account. Both procedures are reused without new apparatus assumptions.
rationales.misconception: Combine the existing direct-contact magnetic-transfer mistake with the existing reply-role reversal mistake: close the pole gap and assign motion to pole pressure, then reverse the receiver/transmitter conversion functions when the speaker changes.

rationales.derivation: Definitions 0, 2 and 3 establish mouth-side transmitting and ear-side receiving conversion directions. Definitions 1 and 8 give the transmitter parts, diaphragm material alternatives, shoe and electrode insulation and supplied-current path. Definitions 10 through 13 establish air/diaphragm motion, changing carbon contacts and pressure, changing resistance and supplied current, unchanged AB under fixed conditions and pulsating DC BC without reversal. Definitions 15 and 18 supply the receiver housing, permanent magnet and poles, fine-wire coils, circular steel diaphragm, cover and small gap, with permanent attraction at zero coil current, static displacement at constant current, and changing combined magnetic attraction at varying current. Definition 19 supplies local diaphragm/air sound recreation. Combining those causal stages and applying the same respective devices to the opposite person's reply gives the stated two-way chain. No quantitative graph claim or unprovided circuit polarity is required.

Retain the original small-gap magnetic receiver section and combine two existing physical mistakes elsewhere. Infer electrical connection from mechanical mounting, make carbon shoe 2 and base electrode 3 conductively contact housing 1, reduce pad 4 to a fixing pad, and put the housing in the supplied-current route instead of the carbon shoe. These steps generate the transmitter section but contradict definitions 1 and 8. Next reverse each transducer's conversion direction when who speaks reverses, assigning reply air-to-current conversion to the other person's receiver and current-to-sound conversion to the original person's transmitter. This generates the conversation section but contradicts the unchanged respective functions in definitions 0, 2 and 3. Either error makes the complete account false. Their coexistence does not revise the source model or introduce a fourth contrast family.
rationales.misconception: Combine the existing mounting/electrical-continuity mistake with the existing reply-role reversal mistake: erase housing insulation and substitute the housing in the current path, then swap the physical devices' conversion functions on reply.

omitted_tasks: Independently producing the two definitions, their conversion directions and explanatory wording without presented candidates.
coverage.reason: The mouth-side microphone and ear-side receiver definitions are retained in the full model candidates and their functional distinction also governs the reply. They are integrated with the physically connected construction/operation and conversation tasks rather than reduced to selecting device labels. Recognition is not evidence of independently writing those definitions.

omitted_tasks: Independently writing the full transmitter construction description and powered resistance-modulation explanation, including materials, insulation, current path and no-sound versus sound-driven current states.
coverage.reason: Candidates preserve all six numbered construction roles, steel/pressed-carbon diaphragm, powder recess, shoe/pad and electrode insulation, current path, air/diaphragm/contact-pressure/resistance/current causation, supplied energy, unchanged AB and non-reversing pulsating BC. A substantive construction-and-path misconception is contrasted with the source model. The capacity loss is producing an explanation, not silent removal of these conceptual facets; graph calibration is neither available nor claimed.

omitted_tasks: Independently writing the full receiver construction description and magnetic-to-diaphragm-to-air account for zero, constant and varying coil-current states.
coverage.reason: Candidates preserve all five numbered parts, permanent magnet/two poles/fine-wire coils, circular steel diaphragm, cover support and small pole gap, permanent attraction without coil current, static displacement under constant current, combined varying field/attraction and local sound production. A contact-transfer misconception tests the essential gap and magnetic actuation together. Recognition of this complete account does not prove the learner can independently construct the explanation.

omitted_tasks: Independently generating, ordering and explaining the entire two-way conversation chain without a complete model being offered.
coverage.reason: The integrated candidates contain vocal-fold/air motion, transmitter carbon mechanism, supplied-current modulation, electrical transmission, receiver coil/magnet/force/diaphragm/local-air chain and reply roles. They retain electrical rather than airborne-sound transmission and locally regenerated sound; a reverse-transducer-role misconception addresses the return direction. Definitions and device facets are merged because they are consecutive necessary parts of this one physical route, not because of a fixed question count. No detailed circuit topology or quantitative reproduction criterion was present in the source.
